name: falcon_public_graph
title: Read the public market graph
description: Read the fixed Solana Devnet market graph and technical program/reserve observations for the legacy lending tools. Anonymous and read-only; no wallet, funds, login, or signer. OBSERVED is not a personalized decision or execution approval. No custom graph selector is accepted.

name: falcon_connect
title: Start wallet sign-in
description: Step 1 of sign-in. Pass your base58 Solana wallet address. Show the returned message to your human; the human must check the host and sign the exact UTF-8 message with wallet signMessage before falcon_connect_verify.

name: falcon_connect_verify
title: Finish wallet sign-in
description: Step 2 of sign-in. Pass the challengeId and the Ed25519 signature of the message (64 bytes, base64 or base58). Returns a session token valid for 30 minutes. This is the only tool that returns a session.

signature.description: Signature of the exact message, 64 bytes, base64 or base58.

name: falcon_disconnect
title: End session
description: Revoke the session at Falcon. The wallet key is not involved.

name: falcon_yield_opportunities
title: Read yield opportunities
description: Read the current Solana lending yield opportunities from Falcon. Read-only. Data is provider-indexed and APY is not a realized return.

name: falcon_refresh_evidence
title: Adopt public Devnet evidence
description: Adopt the exact current fixed public graph revision into owner-bound program and reserve records. Returns both owner analysis IDs, graphRevision, evidenceSource, and technical analysis results. It does not recapture or substitute older evidence.

name: falcon_reserve_decision
title: Get reserve decision
description: Evaluate a human-proposed Devnet supply against the public graph evidence adopted by falcon_refresh_evidence. Requires its analysisId and explicit proposed amount, maximum, book-liquidity floor, and maximum evidence age; no owner limits are defaulted. REVIEW is not execution approval.

analysisId.description: Program analysisId returned by falcon_refresh_evidence for the public graph revision.

proposedUsdc.description: proposedUsdc as a decimal USDC string, at most 6 decimals, no exponent or sign.

maxUsdc.description: maxUsdc as a decimal USDC string, at most 6 decimals, no exponent or sign.

minBookLiquidityUsdc.description: minBookLiquidityUsdc as a decimal USDC string, at most 6 decimals, no exponent or sign.

maxEvidenceAgeSeconds.description: Oldest acceptable evidence age in seconds, 1 to 300; supplied by the human.

name: falcon_prepare_transaction
title: Prepare unsigned Devnet transaction
description: Prepare a Devnet supply or redeem only from an adopted public graph analysis. Supply requires amountUsdc and the durable decisionId returned by a matching public REVIEW; redeem requires amountReceiptTokens and forbids amountUsdc and decisionId. The wallet is derived from the session. The human alone chooses whether to sign and broadcasts; this unsigned intent expires in about 120 seconds.

amountUsdc.description: Decimal USDC amount with at most 6 fractional digits; required for supply and forbidden for redeem.

amountReceiptTokens.description: Decimal receipt-token burn amount with at most 6 fractional digits; required for redeem and forbidden for supply.

analysisId.description: UUID returned by falcon_refresh_evidence; required for supply and redeem.

decisionId.description: Durable UUID returned by falcon_reserve_decision for supply; forbidden for redeem. Graph-local policy identifiers are not substitutes.

name: falcon_submit_signed
title: Register signed transaction
description: Register wallet-signed transaction bytes (base64) with Falcon. Falcon verifies them against the prepared intent and never broadcasts. Only the human may broadcast the same signed bytes to Solana Devnet.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse it only to retry the same submission.

name: falcon_check_receipt
title: Check transaction receipt
description: Ask Falcon to reconcile the registered transaction against Solana Devnet and record the result.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse it only to retry the same check.

name: falcon_activity
title: Read activity trail
description: Read the recent decisions and prepared transactions for this wallet, joined by decision, with each transaction's latest status. Read-only.

name: falcon_wallet_status
title: Read Devnet wallet status
description: Public read-only account inspection for a base58 Solana wallet on Devnet; no wallet session or Bearer token is sent. Returns the Mesh status fields and human-only faucet guidance. It does not prove signing or transaction readiness.

wallet.description: Base58 Solana wallet address to inspect.

forAction.description: Optional action context for the read-only status response.

name: falcon_decode_transaction
title: Decode a Solana transaction
description: Public read-only Devnet transaction inspection. Accepts bounded base64 bytes and returns decoded message/signature context and risk flags; no session, signing, simulation, or broadcast occurs. Context attestation reflects only the requested chain and network.

transactionBase64.description: Base64-encoded serialized Solana transaction, maximum 1644 characters (1232 bytes).

name: falcon_self_test
title: Read MCP metadata self-test
description: Metadata-only report of server version, tool schemas, publisher-reported NEAR/mainnet research scope, and legacy Solana/Devnet tool scope, including the verified host/operator grant required for research review. Unlisted capabilities are unsupported. It does not probe Mesh, health, backend readiness, signer support, funds, transaction readiness, or whether a research grant is configured or verified.

name: falcon_research_case
title: Read a public NEAR research case
description: Read the latest or a saved publisher-reported NEAR/mainnet public research case. Anonymous: no session, owner data, or authorization token is accepted or sent. Omit caseId to read the latest case or provide a UUID to read one saved case. Publisher-reported content is not independently verified and does not establish portfolio status or execution readiness.

caseId.description: Optional public case UUID; omit to read the latest case.

name: falcon_replay_research_case
title: Replay a public NEAR research case
description: Request a replay of a publisher-reported NEAR/mainnet public research case. Anonymous: no session, owner data, or authorization token is accepted or sent. This returns the bounded backend report and is not independent verification, a recommendation, or execution approval.

name: falcon_research_source
title: Read a public NEAR research source
description: Read one publisher-reported NEAR/mainnet public source revision. Anonymous: no session, owner data, or authorization token is accepted or sent. Returned source material is publisher-reported and does not establish portfolio status or execution readiness.

revisionId.description: Publisher source revision UUID to read.

name: falcon_adopt_research_case
title: Adopt a NEAR research case
description: Create an authenticated owner-bound adoption for a public NEAR/mainnet research case. Requires a Falcon wallet session. Supply and reuse the exact requestId to retry the same adoption; this tool never generates an idempotency key. Adoption is not spending or execution authorization.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied UUID idempotency key; reuse exactly for a retry.

publicCaseId.description: UUID of the public research case to adopt.

name: falcon_review_research_case
title: Request a NEAR research review
description: Submit an authenticated asynchronous review of an adopted analysis for a public NEAR/mainnet research case. Requires a Falcon wallet session and a verified host/operator grant. Returns the retained job envelope promptly; it does not wait for model computation. Supply and reuse the exact requestId to retry the same submission. A review is not spending or execution authorization.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied UUID idempotency key; reuse exactly for a retry.

analysisId.description: UUID of the adopted research analysis to review.
